top_stories.title: Danish university DTU breach exposes data of up to 200,000 people
top_stories.summary: The Technical University of Denmark (DTU) suffered a breach in which hackers accessed its identity and access management system and downloaded data belonging to up to 200,000 people. The attack directly targeted the IAM infrastructure, resulting in the exposure of user information at scale.

top_stories.title: Okta XAA Ecosystem Scales to 25+ Partners as AI Gateways Become the Identity Enforcement Layer
top_stories.summary: Okta's Cross App Access (XAA) protocol ecosystem has scaled to 25+ partners, with AI gateway vendor TrueFoundry becoming the latest to integrate the protocol. The integration positions AI gateways as identity enforcement layers where agents present credentials before accessing downstream resources.

top_stories.title: Aembit Becomes First Third-Party Enforcement Point for Okta’s XAA Agent Identity Protocol
top_stories.summary: Aembit has become the first third-party enforcement point for Okta's Cross App Access (XAA) protocol, an open agent identity standard Okta formalized at Oktane in September 2026. XAA is designed to standardize enterprise-managed authorization for agentic and cross-application access scenarios, and Aembit's adoption marks the first external implementation of the protocol.

top_stories.title: Oktane 2026 Recap: Okta Announces A Unified IAM Control Plane, With Agent Governance And Identity Details Remaining Unclear
top_stories.summary: At Oktane 2026 in Las Vegas, Okta announced plans to transform its platform into a unified IAM control plane with AI agent governance capabilities. Key details around agent identity and governance implementation remain unclear following the conference keynotes and product announcements.

top_stories.title: Dual NetScaler Zero-Days Trigger Chaos for Citrix Customers
top_stories.summary: Citrix disclosed two critical zero-day vulnerabilities in its NetScaler products that affect default configurations and allow attackers unauthorized access to customer networks. The flaws are particularly relevant to IAM and access management professionals as NetScaler is widely used as an application delivery and access gateway solution.

news.title: Keyorix: Open-source secrets management for teams that can’t use SaaS
news.summary: Keyorix SL has launched Keyorix, an open-source, self-hosted secrets manager that stores database passwords, API keys, and tokens on a company's own servers without requiring internet connectivity. The tool ships as a single binary and targets organizations that cannot send credentials to cloud-based SaaS platforms.

news.title: New NetScaler Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks Can Knock SAML Deployments Offline
news.summary: Citrix has released security updates for a high-severity zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-88779, CVSS 8.7) in NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway that is being actively exploited in targeted attacks. The memory overflow vulnerability can knock SAML deployments offline, directly impacting identity federation and authentication infrastructure.

news.title: Citrix patches NetScaler SAML zero-day exploited in attacks
news.summary: Citrix released emergency patches for a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-88779) in NetScaler affecting SAML functionality that has been actively exploited in denial-of-service attacks. Researchers are investigating whether the flaw can also be leveraged for remote code execution.

news.title: China-Aligned TA419 Targets U.S. AI Policy Experts With Microsoft AitM Phishing
news.summary: A China-aligned threat group designated TA419 has been conducting credential phishing campaigns targeting AI policy experts at U.S. think tanks, universities, and legal organizations. The attacks use Microsoft Adversary-in-the-Middle (AitM) phishing techniques, impersonating economists, AI policymakers, and an Anthropic employee to steal credentials.

news.title: Why Okta Tripled on … 11% Growth. 5 Interesting Learnings From One of the Biggest Re-Ratings in B2B This Year: 14% cRPO Growth, 30% of Bookings From New Products, and ~50x Forward Earnings
news.summary: The article analyzes Okta's stock performance and financial metrics, noting the company tripled in value despite modest 11% growth, with 14% cRPO growth and 30% of bookings from new products. The piece is primarily a financial/investment analysis of Okta's market re-rating rather than coverage of IAM products, features, or security developments.

news.title: Kiteworks & Citrix Incidents Show Challenges of Zero-Day Response
news.summary: Kiteworks and Citrix both faced zero-day vulnerability incidents that revealed contrasting approaches to incident response and customer communication. Kiteworks instructed customers to power down its data-protection platform during a nine-hour window, while Citrix remained silent on reported attacks before releasing a patch.

news.title: SWIFT Banking & Government Middleware Enables RCE
news.summary: A vulnerability in SWIFT banking and government middleware has been identified that enables remote code execution (RCE). The flaw can be exploited to bypass hardware-based MFA in high-security environments, with patching recommended as the immediate mitigation.

news.title: Chinese spies impersonate White House, Anthropic figures to phish AI policy experts
news.summary: A China-aligned espionage group tracked as TA419 conducted credential phishing campaigns in July 2026, impersonating a former White House Office of Science and Technology Policy official and an economist to gain access to cloud accounts of AI policy experts. Proofpoint researchers identified the campaigns, which targeted account credentials rather than exploiting IAM platform vulnerabilities.

news.title: Dell CSM Flaws Enable Unauthenticated Admin Access and Root on Kubernetes Nodes
news.summary: Dell has released security updates addressing critical vulnerabilities in Dell Container Storage Modules (CSM), including CVE-2026-63688 (CVSS 10.0), which allows unauthenticated access to critical functions via the csm-authorization-storage gRPC server. The flaws enable unauthenticated admin access and root-level compromise on Kubernetes nodes, directly impacting Dell's CSM authorization component.

news.title: Why CISOs Struggle to Answer the Board's Three Hardest Questions, and How to Fix the Report
news.summary: The article addresses the challenge CISOs face in reporting security posture to boards, with identity provider data being one of several sources used to build security reports. The content focuses broadly on board reporting methodology rather than IAM-specific topics, though identity data is mentioned as one input among many.

news.title: CISA Adds Exploited Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Auth Bypass to KEV
news.summary: CISA added a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (CVE-2026-76504, CVSS 9.8) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following reports of active exploitation. The flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to access affected systems, making it directly relevant to IAM professionals concerned with authentication security.

news.title: Citrix NetScaler Post-Exploitation Payload Creates Superuser, Maps Web Shell to CSS-Like URLs
news.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a critical pre-authentication command injection vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway to deploy web shells and steal configuration data. The attacks involve creating superuser accounts and mapping web shells to CSS-like URLs, with LevelBlue's THOR team identifying the activity across multiple customer environments.

news.title: Ditto Named a Product Leader in KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity Verification
news.summary: Ditto has been named a Product Leader in the KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity Verification. The recognition highlights Ditto's binding of verified identity to high-assurance authentication and its no-code orchestration layer.

news.title: Microsoft enables Windows settings backup by default for orgs
news.summary: Microsoft has enabled Windows settings backup and restore by default for all Microsoft Entra-joined or hybrid-joined enterprise systems upgraded to Windows 11 26H2. The change affects organizations using Microsoft Entra for device identity management and join configurations.

news.title: Keeper Security Freshservice Workflow App Streamlines Vault and Privileged Access Request Process
news.summary: Keeper Security has launched a new integration between its password/PAM platform and Freshservice, enabling IT and security teams to search the Keeper vault and submit privileged access requests directly from the Freshservice ticket sidebar. The integration connects Keeper's zero-trust, zero-knowledge vault capabilities with Freshservice's IT service management workflows to streamline privileged access request processes.

news.title: From Shadow AI to Accountable Agents: Why Agent Governance Needs Enforcement
news.summary: The article addresses the need for identity governance frameworks to adapt to the proliferation of AI agents in enterprise environments. It argues that traditional IAM approaches must shift to dynamic, continuous monitoring models to manage the risks posed by autonomous AI agents.

news.title: Attackers Exploit Zimbra Flaw to Deploy Web Shells and Harvest Authentication Secrets
news.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a patched Zimbra Collaboration Suite vulnerability (CVE-2026-73570, CVSS 8.9) to deploy web shells and harvest authentication secrets from mailboxes. The unauthenticated OS command injection flaw enables remote code execution via SNMP, with findings reported by Microsoft Security Research.

news.title: Cisco Warns of Attackers Exploiting Critical Authentication Bypass in SD-WAN Manager
news.summary: Cisco disclosed a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-76504) in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager that allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to access the system's API with admin-level privileges. The flaw is being actively exploited in the wild, fixed releases are available, and no workaround exists.

news.title: keycloak v26.7.5
news.summary: Keycloak has released version 26.7.5 of its open source identity and access management platform. The release continues support for modern applications and services, though specific changelog details are not provided in the description.

news.title: AI Agents Are Privileged Users; Who Is Auditing Their Access?
news.summary: The article examines AI agents operating within enterprise environments with broad privileged access, drawing parallels to insider threat risks traditionally associated with human users. The piece addresses gaps in auditing and access governance for autonomous AI agents, touching on PAM and identity governance considerations relevant to IAM practitioners.

news.title: JadePuffer AI Actor Compromises Azure Tenant in Destructive Cloud Attack
news.summary: A threat actor named JadePuffer compromised an Azure tenant in a destructive cloud attack, deleting cloud-based storage, applications, and databases. The actor allegedly used exposed credentials to gain initial access, highlighting risks around credential management and cloud identity security.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian drivers licenses, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official inquiry into the breach.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in data theft including over 100 million AT&T customer records.
